summary_points: Flowserve is a world leader in pump engineering and manufacturing.
They have extensive experience with molten salt pumps dating back to the 1940s.
Flowserve offers comprehensive product support and training services.
Their products cover a wide range of temperatures from 290ºC to 790ºC.
Flowserve has local pump repair centers worldwide.
The document covers the technical scope of supply for vertical molten salt pumps.
Pumps include features like flanged bowls, renewable wear rings, and enclosed impellers.
Testing includes performance, hydrostatic, and submergence tests.
Special documentation and packaging are provided with the pump.
The pump is designed for continuous operation at 110% Qd and Run-out>120% Qd.
It operates under a maximum operating design flow rate of 137.4 USgpm and head of 59.00 ft.
The pump has a motor exit power of 6.86 kW and an efficiency of at least 68.74%
Special accessories include reverse speed sensors, vibration detectors, RTD, manometers, and refrigeration system.
Construction materials include ASTM A-434 Gr. BC 4140 for casing, ASTM A216 Gr. WCB for shaft sleeves, and ASTMA-487 Grade CA6NM for impeller.
Pump service is for a TES Drain Tank Pump.
Capacity is 137.4 USgpm at 59 ft height.
Material used is MSP with a temperature of 750 °F / 1.907.
Hydraulic selection follows API 610 10th Edition.
Maximum suction pressure not applicable.
Total head ratio (rated/max) is 94.1%.
Coupling bellows are optional and not included in base price.
FCA terms for USA end user and manufacturing location.
Anchor plate not within Flowserve scope.
No spare parts recommended for commissioning/start up.
Discuss additional testing requirements prior to purchase order.
Servicing as per attached field service rates, with scope identified before PO.
Standard domestic inland freight packing instead of seaworthy packing.
Flowserve schedules shipment based on PO delivery date.
Quoted INCO terms FCA, Flowserve factory basis not applicable to Flowserve.
Sound test at factory for reference only.
Supervisor有权监督装配和启动，并在发现不适当的情况时随时暂停工作。
对于未明确规定的事项，应遵循Abeinsa批准的标准测试部分。
供应商将保证提供的离心泵满足本技术规范及合同文件的所有要求。
保修期为设备自临时验收之日起两年的连续运行时间。
保修期内，供应商有权访问工厂检查设备。
噪声水平应低于85 dBA。
供应商需提供所有必要的手段，并免费交付进行测试所需的材料样本。
系统元素必须符合合同文件的要求。
